//: ESLint-only TSConfig. The typescript-eslint parser uses this as its `defaultProject` fallback for the TS files that live outside tsconfig.json's `include` (scripts/, tests/smoke/, root *.config.ts). `bun run typecheck` never reads this file - it keeps using tsconfig.json unchanged.
//rootDir: tsconfig.json pins rootDir to src/. Files outside src/ would trigger TS6059 ('not under rootDir'), which the parser rethrows as a parse error. Widening rootDir here is safe: the parser only reads types, it never emits.
